g.text: Live: the same architecture in the ArgoCD UI (real screenshots, make up on kind)
Left: the root app (app of apps) creates the platform apps, the 2 AppProjects and the ApplicationSet, which fans out to the 9 service apps.
CI writes to Git and the registry only. ArgoCD runs inside the cluster and pulls. Numbers follow one change from PR to prod.
commit tag to gitops-config/ (dev, qa PR)
GitOps namespaces (label gitops.demo/protected=true -> only ArgoCD may change them)
